about: FPV Simulator is a first person view racing drone simulator for beginners or advanced pilots.

If you are a total beginner pilot you can complete the flight school which teaches you the fundamental fpv drone racing gates and controls. Predefined settings help you to get into the world of FPV Racing.
Take one step at a time and start with the beginner mode where the tilt angle is locked like training wheels .

After you get comfortable with the controls go to the next level with the intermediate mode and finally advance to the pro mode which unlocks the full potential of FPV like freestyle tricks and fast racing times.
Setup your stick sensitivity in the settings tab and use from predefined values to create your customized stick setup. Chose your transmitter mode from mode 1 to mode 4.
Two game modes are included namely the Time Trial mode where you try to beat your last best time and free flight mode where you can fly around and do some freestyle tricks.
summary: Feel the rush and the freedom of flying like a bird trying to defy gravity
